openIssues.summary: Share preview y-position differs across current evidence artifacts and must be reconciled on current production.
Desktop 1440px share evidence still records a narrow preview width that can read as a mobile card.
Documents default is improved, but viewport-first IA should be verified against the exact current production surface.

documentsDefault: field-mode safety brief, top hazards, core document status, and next action visible in the first viewport
full document preview and editor closed behind explicit deep-review disclosure by default
shareDesktop: primary controls visible before the fold
preview/status/warnings shown as a contextual desktop pane rather than a narrow centered mobile card
shareMobile: message preview and send CTA reachable without excessive scroll
details, evidence, logs, and history folded by default
